boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain George Fox University
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe Newberg food destinations with current, directly documented late hours.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Portland Road
cards.subtitle: 3420 Portland Road, Newberg
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru when you need a food stop after evening commitments; confirm the day’s posted hours before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A Newberg drive-thru with the latest documented hours in this set.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru service until 3 a.m. Sunday through Thursday and 4 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 3420 Portland Road, Newberg
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru: 6 a.m.–3 a.m. Sunday–Thursday; 6 a.m.–4 a.m. Friday–Saturday. Dine-in is listed until midnight.

cards.title: Burgerville on Portland Road
cards.subtitle: 2514 Portland Road, Newberg
cards.notes: Plan a sit-down or takeout meal before the posted 11 p.m. close; the location notes delivery and order-ahead end earlier.
cards.short_summary: A Portland Road burger stop open nightly through 11 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Burgerville lists this Newberg location as open 9 a.m.–11 p.m. every day.
cards.source_title: Burgerville — Newberg
cards.access_notes: Open daily 9 a.m.–11 p.m.; the official page says order-ahead and delivery hours end 30 minutes earlier.

cards.title: Subway at Harrison Street
cards.subtitle: 100 S Harrison St, Newberg
cards.notes: Choose pickup, delivery, or an in-restaurant stop before 9:30 p.m.; this is the later-listed of the two Newberg Subway locations.
cards.short_summary: A downtown sandwich option with daily service through 9:30 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Subway lists its 100 S Harrison St restaurant open 9:30 a.m.–9:30 p.m. every day.
cards.source_title: Subway — 100 S Harrison St, Newberg
cards.access_notes: Store hours are listed as 9:30 a.m.–9:30 p.m. daily; pickup and delivery are available.

cards.title: DQ Grill & Chill on West First
cards.subtitle: 404 W 1st St, Newberg
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru for a late food or treat stop; its posted closing time runs 30 minutes later than the dining room.
cards.short_summary: A First Street drive-thru available through 10 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Dairy Queen lists drive-thru hours until 10 p.m. daily at 404 W 1st St.
cards.source_title: DQ Grill & Chill — Newberg
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru: 10 a.m.–10 p.m. daily. Store and delivery are listed until 9:30 p.m.

cards.title: Eduardo’s Taco Shop
cards.subtitle: 1008 N Springbrook Rd, Newberg
cards.notes: Place a pickup order through the restaurant’s site, then allow time for its manual confirmation before heading out for food.
cards.short_summary: A Springbrook Road Mexican-food pickup option open until 10 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Eduardo’s Taco Shop lists daily hours of 8 a.m.–10 p.m. and offers pickup ordering.
cards.source_title: Eduardo's Taco Shop
cards.access_notes: Open daily 8 a.m.–10 p.m.; the official site states that online pickup orders are manually confirmed.

cards.title: Five Guys at Crestview
cards.subtitle: 4205 E Crestview Dr, Newberg
cards.notes: Use the official location page to check same-day service, then choose dine-in, takeout, or delivery before the listed close.
cards.short_summary: A Crestview burger-and-fries destination open through 10 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Five Guys lists its Newberg store at 4205 E Crestview Dr as closing at 10 p.m.
cards.source_title: Five Guys — Newberg
cards.access_notes: The official location page lists store service until 10 p.m. and delivery until 9:30 p.m.; dine-in, takeout, and delivery are offered.

cards.title: MOD Pizza at Crestview
cards.subtitle: 4105 E Crestview Dr, Suite 101, Newberg
cards.notes: Check the day before going: Thursday through Saturday have the latest posted close, while other nights end at 10 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A pizza stop whose weekend hours extend to 11 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: MOD Pizza lists this Newberg restaurant open until 11 p.m. Thursday through Saturday and until 10 p.m. other days.
cards.source_title: MOD Pizza Newberg
cards.access_notes: Open until 11 p.m. Thursday–Saturday; open until 10 p.m. Sunday–Wednesday. Pickup and delivery are listed.

cards.title: Clementine on East First
cards.subtitle: 611 E 1st St, Newberg
cards.notes: Check the restaurant’s official page on the day of your visit, especially if you are planning a later dinner in downtown Newberg.
cards.short_summary: A downtown Newberg restaurant currently showing midnight service today.
cards.evidence_claim: Clementine’s official site lists its address at 611 E 1st St and currently shows service until 12 a.m. today.
cards.source_title: Clementine
cards.access_notes: The official page currently displays: “Open today | 11:30 am – 12:00 am.” Recheck before visiting because the page presents today’s hours.

cards.title: Chipotle on East Portland Road
cards.subtitle: 3105 E Portland Rd, Newberg
cards.notes: Order a customizable burrito, bowl, taco, salad, or quesadilla for pickup, delivery, or an in-store meal before 11 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A Portland Road fast-casual restaurant open every night through 11 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Chipotle lists its 3105 E Portland Rd restaurant open 10:45 a.m.–11 p.m. Monday through Sunday.
cards.source_title: Chipotle Mexican Grill — Newberg
cards.access_notes: Restaurant hours are listed as 10:45 a.m.–11 p.m. daily; in-store pickup and delivery are available.

cards.entity_name: La Sierra Newberg Mexican Restaurant & Cantina
cards.title: La Sierra on Springbrook Road
cards.subtitle: 705 N Springbrook Rd, Newberg
cards.notes: Use this as a full-service dinner option before its posted 10 p.m. close, and keep plans centered on its food service.
cards.short_summary: A Springbrook Road Mexican restaurant with daily hours through 10 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: La Sierra’s official site lists the Newberg restaurant at 705 N Springbrook Rd and hours of 11 a.m.–10 p.m. Monday through Sunday.
cards.source_title: La Sierra Newberg Mexican Restaurant & Cantina
cards.access_notes: Open daily 11 a.m.–10 p.m., according to the restaurant’s official contact page.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten documented campus spaces for studying, making, gathering, performance, recreation and reflection.

cards.title: Murdock Library 24-hour Space
cards.subtitle: Murdock Library · Newberg campus
cards.notes: Use your George Fox ID card for around-the-clock access; choose a couch, armchair, standing table or group table near printers and water.
cards.short_summary: An ID-card-accessible collaborative library area with individual and group seating.
cards.evidence_claim: Murdock Library’s main-floor 24-hour space is available to the George Fox community via ID card access around the clock and includes varied seating, printers and water access.
cards.source_title: Library Spaces & Labs | George Fox University
cards.access_notes: George Fox community ID card access is required for the 24-hour space.

cards.title: Murdock Library Fireside Area
cards.subtitle: Murdock Library main floor · Newberg campus
cards.notes: Bring a reading assignment or meet a classmate for a low-key discussion in the main floor’s couch-and-armchair seating area.
cards.short_summary: A main-floor library seating area intended for comfortable reading or discussion.
cards.evidence_claim: The center of Murdock Library’s main floor has a fireside area with couches and armchairs for reading or discussion.
cards.source_title: Library Spaces & Labs | George Fox University
cards.access_notes: Located on the library’s main floor; follow library access and study-space policies.

cards.title: Murdock Library Special Collections Room
cards.subtitle: Murdock Library second floor · Newberg campus
cards.notes: Plan a group work session around the large tables and rolling whiteboards, then take in the windows facing the lawn and canyon.
cards.short_summary: A windowed second-floor room with tables and whiteboards for group work.
cards.evidence_claim: Murdock Library’s Special Collections Room has floor-to-ceiling windows over the lawn and canyon, plus large tables and rolling whiteboards for group work.
cards.source_title: Library Spaces & Labs | George Fox University
cards.access_notes: Located on the second floor; follow library rules and any room-use guidance.

cards.title: Murdock Library Archives/Bound Periodicals Space
cards.subtitle: Murdock Library basement · Newberg campus
cards.notes: Head downstairs when you need a quieter work setting; use the large tables or individual carrels, and keep archive materials handled as directed.
cards.short_summary: A quieter basement library area with tables and individual carrels.
cards.evidence_claim: The Murdock Library basement’s Archives/Bound Periodicals space has large tables and individual carrels, and the library identifies the basement as often its quietest floor.
cards.source_title: Library Spaces & Labs | George Fox University
cards.access_notes: Located in the library basement; follow archive and library access guidance.

cards.title: Hadlock Student Center
cards.subtitle: 1400 E. Sherman St · Newberg campus
cards.notes: Sign the required waiver and bring your university ID, then use the courts, climbing wall, track, fitness center or studios during posted hours.
cards.short_summary: A campus recreation center with courts, climbing, fitness, an indoor track and studios.
cards.evidence_claim: Hadlock Student Center has three full courts, a climbing wall, fitness center, elevated indoor track and fitness studios; eligible students must sign a waiver for access.
cards.source_title: Hadlock Student Center | George Fox University
cards.access_notes: Eligible George Fox students must sign the campus waiver; current university ID is required for entry. Posted academic-year hours run as late as 11 p.m. Monday–Thursday.

cards.title: Canyon Commons
cards.subtitle: Newberg campus · overlooking Hess Creek Canyon
cards.notes: Meet over a meal in the main dining area, or use the smaller meeting spaces to continue a conversation after eating.
cards.short_summary: A 900-seat dining facility with canyon views, meeting spaces and a café.
cards.evidence_claim: Canyon Commons is a 30,000-square-foot dining facility with a main dining area, smaller meeting spaces and a café; the university says students gather there to eat.
cards.source_title: Canyon Commons | Virtual Tour | George Fox University
cards.access_notes: Dining and café purchases or applicable meal-plan access may be required.

cards.title: The Chapel
cards.subtitle: Near Hess Creek Canyon · Newberg campus
cards.notes: Visit for a quiet moment in the contemplation garden, or check the university calendar for special faith services, worship and music performances.
cards.short_summary: A 2024 campus chapel with a contemplation garden and programmed faith and music uses.
cards.evidence_claim: The Chapel opened in 2024 and includes a garden for contemplation and prayer; the campus community uses it for special faith services, contemplative worship and music performances.
cards.source_title: The Chapel | Virtual Tour | George Fox University
cards.access_notes: A sacred campus space; event access may vary.

cards.title: Bauman Auditorium
cards.subtitle: Newberg campus
cards.notes: Check campus arts and chapel schedules for lectures, concerts or productions, and arrive with enough time to find seating before the program begins.
cards.short_summary: A 1,119-seat auditorium used almost daily for chapel and performing arts.
cards.evidence_claim: Bauman Auditorium seats 1,119 and is used almost daily for chapel, theatrical productions, special lectures, and band, choir and orchestra concerts.
cards.source_title: Bauman Auditorium | Virtual Tour | George Fox University
cards.access_notes: Program admission and access depend on the specific event.

cards.title: Engineering Maker Hub
cards.subtitle: Newberg campus
cards.notes: Bring a project idea to the shared Hub; use its collaboration space, meeting rooms and fabrication resources according to facility guidance.
cards.short_summary: A design, prototyping and fabrication facility available to all George Fox students.
cards.evidence_claim: The 16,000-square-foot Engineering Maker Hub is available to all George Fox students and includes fabrication labs, a computing lab, meeting rooms and a shared collaboration space called the Hub.
cards.source_title: Engineering Maker Hub | Virtual Tour | George Fox University
cards.access_notes: Available to George Fox students; equipment use may require training or follow facility rules.

cards.title: Hess Creek Canyon
cards.subtitle: Center of the Newberg campus
cards.notes: Take a calm walk through the 15-acre green space, stay on established campus routes, and pause to notice the creek and native Northwest plants.
cards.short_summary: A campus canyon with a creek and 15 acres of native Northwest greenery.
cards.evidence_claim: Hess Creek Canyon runs through the center of campus and provides 15 acres of green space with native Northwest flora and a meandering creek.
cards.source_title: The Canyon | Virtual Tour | George Fox University
cards.access_notes: Use established campus paths and observe posted site guidance.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct study environments documented at Murdock Library on George Fox University’s Newberg campus.

cards.title: Murdock Library 24-hour Space
cards.subtitle: Murdock Library main floor
cards.notes: Bring your George Fox ID for around-the-clock entry, then choose from individual or group tables, couches, standing tables, or armchairs.
cards.short_summary: An ID-access study area with varied seating and nearby essentials.
cards.evidence_claim: The main-floor 24-hour space is available to the George Fox community by ID card around the clock and includes group and individual seating.
cards.source_title: Library Spaces & Labs | George Fox University
cards.access_notes: Available around the clock to the George Fox community via ID card access.

cards.title: Murdock Library Fireside Area
cards.subtitle: Murdock Library main floor
cards.notes: Settle into a couch or armchair for reading or a low-key discussion; plan for more activity on the main floor between class periods.
cards.short_summary: Soft seating by the fireplace for reading or conversation.
cards.evidence_claim: Murdock Library’s main floor has a fireside area with couches and armchairs for comfortable reading or discussion.
cards.source_title: Library Spaces & Labs | George Fox University
cards.access_notes: Located on the main floor; the library notes this floor is often conversational between class periods.

cards.title: Murdock Library Commons Lab
cards.subtitle: Murdock Library main floor
cards.notes: Use a Mac or Windows computer when your work needs campus software, database access, or a connected local printer; ask the desk for basic help.
cards.short_summary: A main-floor computer workspace with printing and research access.
cards.evidence_claim: The Murdock Library Commons Lab provides Mac and Windows computers, local printing, and onsite access to library databases.
cards.source_title: Library Spaces & Labs | George Fox University
cards.access_notes: Library patrons may use the computers; actively enrolled students receive priority during key academic-calendar periods.

cards.title: Murdock Library Upstairs Study Carrels
cards.subtitle: Murdock Library second-floor outer perimeter
cards.notes: Choose a carrel when you need an individual desk with power, light, and shelf space; the stacks separate this area from the main floor activity.
cards.short_summary: Individual powered desks set apart by the library stacks.
cards.evidence_claim: Second-floor study carrels have power strips, a light, and a shelf, and are typically a quieter place to work.
cards.source_title: Library Spaces & Labs | George Fox University
cards.access_notes: Located around the outer perimeter of Murdock Library’s second floor.

cards.title: Murdock Library Upstairs Balcony Tables
cards.subtitle: Murdock Library second-floor inner balconies
cards.notes: Use the tables around the inner balconies when your group wants to work together near the print collections without reserving a room.
cards.short_summary: Second-floor group seating arranged around the inner balconies.
cards.evidence_claim: Murdock Library’s second floor has tables with group seating around its inner balconies.
cards.source_title: Library Spaces & Labs | George Fox University
cards.access_notes: Located on the second floor among the print collections.

cards.title: Murdock Library Special Collections Room
cards.subtitle: Murdock Library second floor
cards.notes: Gather a project group at the large tables and use the rolling whiteboards; the floor-to-ceiling windows look toward the lawn and canyon.
cards.short_summary: A windowed room with large tables and rolling whiteboards.
cards.evidence_claim: The Special Collections Room offers large tables, rolling whiteboards, and floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the lawn and canyon.
cards.source_title: Library Spaces & Labs | George Fox University
cards.access_notes: Located on the second floor; it houses the Quaker collection.

cards.entity_name: Murdock Library Second-Floor Individual Study Rooms
cards.title: Murdock Library Second-Floor Individual Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Murdock Library second floor
cards.notes: Reserve an individual room for focused work, or use it as a drop-in space when unbooked; yield the room if a reservation begins.
cards.short_summary: Five reservable individual rooms for focused academic work.
cards.evidence_claim: Murdock Library has five individual study rooms on its second floor, and unbooked study rooms may be used on a first-come basis.
cards.source_title: Library Spaces & Labs | George Fox University
cards.access_notes: Students may book academic-use rooms for up to four hours per day; drop-in users must leave for a reservation.

cards.entity_name: Murdock Library Main-Floor Group Study Rooms
cards.title: Murdock Library Main-Floor Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Murdock Library main floor
cards.notes: Book one of the five rooms for an academic group session, and check the door signage before dropping in; three rooms can combine into one classroom.
cards.short_summary: Five reservable main-floor rooms for collaborative academic work.
cards.evidence_claim: Murdock Library’s main floor has five group study rooms, three of which can convert into one large classroom.
cards.source_title: Library Spaces & Labs | George Fox University
cards.access_notes: Students may book rooms for academic or George Fox community activities for up to four hours daily; unbooked rooms allow drop-ins.

cards.entity_name: Murdock Library Archives/Bound Periodicals Study Area
cards.title: Murdock Library Archives/Bound Periodicals Study Area
cards.subtitle: Murdock Library basement
cards.notes: Head downstairs for a quieter work setting and select a large table or individual carrel in the Archives and Bound Periodicals area.
cards.short_summary: Basement tables and carrels in one of the library’s quietest areas.
cards.evidence_claim: The basement Archives/Bound Periodicals space has large tables and individual carrels, and the library describes the basement as often its quietest floor.
cards.source_title: Library Spaces & Labs | George Fox University
cards.access_notes: Located in the Murdock Library basement.

cards.title: Murdock Library Juvenile Collections Room
cards.subtitle: Murdock Library basement
cards.notes: Use the basement’s group tables for a collaborative session, especially when you want a library setting away from the main-floor traffic.
cards.short_summary: Basement group tables beside the juvenile collections.
cards.evidence_claim: The Juvenile Collections Room in Murdock Library’s basement provides group tables.
cards.source_title: Library Spaces & Labs | George Fox University
cards.access_notes: Located in the Murdock Library basement.
